title: HELIX EmploymentOutcome Resource
description: A first-destination or ongoing employment outcome for a graduate. Aligned with the NACE (National Association of Colleges and Employers) First-Destination Survey Standards, which define the standard for reporting career outcomes of graduating classes. Captures where and how a graduate is employed, salary, and relationship to the field of study. First-destination data is typically collected at or within six months of graduation.

person_ref.description: HELIX ID of the underlying Person

degree_ref.description: HELIX ID of the Degree this outcome is associated with

academic_year_graduated.description: Graduation aid/academic year in YYYY-YYYY format

outcome_type.description: First-destination outcome category. Bound to HELIX terminology: helix/first-destination-status

employment_relation_to_major.description: How related the position is to the field of study. Bound to HELIX terminology: helix/employment-relation

time_to_hire_days.description: Days from graduation (or job search start) to hire

continuing_education_flag.description: True if the graduate is simultaneously pursuing continuing education

knowledge_source.description: Source of the outcome knowledge for NACE knowledge-rate purposes

meta.description: HELIX metadata block — present on every resource

data_owner.description: Role or person responsible for data quality

classification.description: Data classification tier per HELIX Govern

ferpa_flags.description: FERPA enforcement flags, applied at Bronze->Silver identity resolution and checked by every consumer before disclosure. See govern/ferpa-disclosure-framework.json. First-destination employment data is often collected post-graduation; while tied to the student's education record at graduation, institutions should confirm education-record status for data collected independently after separation.

is_education_record.description: True if this record is a FERPA education record (34 CFR 99.3).

disclosure_basis_required.description: If true, a consumer must assert a valid 34 CFR 99.31 disclosure basis (or hold 99.30 consent) before data is returned.

directory_restricted.description: True when the student has an active directory-information opt-out (from FERPARestriction.restrict_directory). When true, NO directory information may be disclosed under the 99.31(a)(11) directory exception.

restricted_categories.description: Specific directory-information categories the student restricted (99.37). A field in this list must be withheld even if directory_restricted is false.

legitimate_interest_scope.description: Roles/purposes pre-authorized as school officials with legitimate educational interest for this record (drives the 99.31(a)(1) check).

study_disclosure_allowed.description: Whether this record may be released under a 99.31(a)(6) studies agreement (typically de-identified or under a written agreement).
